create_AdaptiveMask: create an AdaptiveMask module with a given size, ramp_size, and init_ratio for adaptive sequence masking
run_AdaptiveMask_forward: run the forward pass of AdaptiveMask to multiply input tensor by an adaptive mask
test_AdaptiveMask_prepare_mask: test the prepare_mask method to precompute and store an adaptive mask for a given span
review_AdaptiveMask_get_max_size: review the get_max_size method that computes the maximum effective mask size from size_ratio
summarize_AdaptiveMask_param_clamp: summarize the param_clamp method that clamps size_ratio parameter values between 0 and 1
